name: Buddy MCP
description: Buddy provides agentic infrastructure for coding agents: sandbox VMs, app and website hosting, git repositories, package registry, domains and CI/CD workflows - so agents can write, review, test, deploy and ship software. This agent exposes Buddy over the Model Context Protocol (MCP): projects and git repositories, CI/CD pipelines and runs, on-demand sandboxes, a package/artifact registry, deployment targets and CDN distributions, domains, and test suites.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with authorization code + PKCE. Protected resource metadata: https://mcp.buddy.works/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. A Buddy personal access token may also be used as a bearer token.

scopes.EXECUTION_RUN: Start, cancel and retry pipeline runs
scopes.DISTRIBUTION_MANAGE: Create and delete distributions and routes

skills.name: Manage projects and git repositories
skills.description: Create, update and delete projects and inspect their git repositories — branches, commits, tags and pull requests.

skills.name: Run and monitor CI/CD pipelines
skills.description: Create and edit pipelines (YAML), start, cancel, retry and approve runs, and read per-action status and logs.

skills.name: Manage sandboxes
skills.description: Create and control on-demand sandbox VMs, run shell commands, transfer files, manage snapshots and run apps inside them.

skills.name: Manage the package and artifact registry
skills.description: Create packages and versions, browse and edit their contents, and upload or download files and ZIP archives.

skills.name: Manage deployment targets and CDN distributions
skills.description: Inspect deployment targets and create distributions with routes that map domains and paths to per-region targets.

skills.name: Manage domains and DNS zones
skills.description: List domains and DNS zones, check availability, suggest and buy domains, and claim free sub-names under Buddy-owned zones.

skills.name: Manage test suites
skills.description: List and create visual, unit and crawl test suites and obtain their run tokens.

skills.name: Inspect workspaces and users
skills.description: Identify the authenticated user, list workspaces and their members, and manage the user's SSH keys.
